title: Episode Six Adds Issuance and Redemption Checks for Tokenized Deposits
why_it_matters: Checking redemption requests before releasing money addresses an operational risk in tokenized banking, but ledger controls alone cannot establish actual reserve sufficiency.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Episode Six Adds Issuance and Redemption Checks for Tokenized Deposits

Verified Backing checks funds recorded on the issuer's ledger and outstanding issuance status, while banks retain responsibility for reserve assurance and regulatory obligations.
